mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, place_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, place_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM post WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 1
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl2 WHERE pl2.post_id = p.id AND pl2.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM post p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 1

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl2 WHERE pl2.post_id = p.id AND pl2.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM post p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, place_id AS placeId, content, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM post ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
